statement: The record shows an active employee (J. Okafor) owed USD 6,200 whose listed bank account is now in a mismatched name (K. Lindqvist) with conflicting change dates.
judge_text:
WRONG

The answer asserts the record is internally inconsistent and mismatched — "bank account is now in a mismatched name (K. Lindqvist) with conflicting change dates" — naming the specific contradiction rather than merely urging verification.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
